answer: Audits are entered in sparrow, queued in trellis, and raven publishes the wait time. A farm of 235 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 96 identities per epoch. A farm of 4631 identities would post 2985 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
